name: Stream-Mapparr
description: Automatically add matching streams to channels based on name similarity and quality precedence. Supports unlimited stream matching, channel visibility management, and CSV export cleanup.
author: PiratesIRC
_fields_note: Settings fields are defined dynamically by the Plugin.fields property in plugin.py (the single source of truth — it builds live dropdowns for channel profiles, groups, stream groups, M3U sources, and the channel database, and stays in sync with the code). Dispatcharr only falls back to a manifest 'fields' array when the plugin provides none, so it is intentionally left empty here to prevent drift (the previous static copy had gone stale).

actions.label: Auto-match after M3U refresh
actions.description: Runs Match & Assign automatically after each M3U refresh when 'Auto-match after M3U refresh' is enabled in settings.

actions.label: ✅ Validate Settings
actions.description: Check database connectivity, profiles, groups, and channel databases.

actions.label: 💾 Update Schedule
actions.description: Save settings and restart the background scheduler.

actions.label: 🧹 Cleanup Orphaned Tasks
actions.description: Remove any orphaned Celery periodic tasks from old plugin versions

confirm.title: Cleanup Orphaned Tasks?
confirm.message: This will remove any old Celery Beat tasks created by previous versions of this plugin. Continue?

actions.label: 👁️ Preview Changes (Dry Run)
actions.description: Generate a CSV preview without making changes.

actions.label: ✅ Match & Assign Streams
actions.description: Match and assign streams to channels.

confirm.title: Match & Assign Streams?
confirm.message: This will match and assign (or preview if dry run enabled) streams to channels. Continue?

actions.label: 🔄 Sort Alternate Streams
actions.description: Sort existing alternate streams by quality.

confirm.title: Sort Alternate Streams?
confirm.message: This will sort (or preview if dry run enabled) existing alternate streams by quality for all channels. Continue?

actions.label: 📡 Match US OTA Only
actions.description: Match US OTA channels by callsign.

confirm.title: Match US OTA Only?
confirm.message: This will match and assign (or preview if dry run enabled) streams to US OTA channels using callsign matching only. Channels without valid US callsigns will be skipped. Continue?

actions.label: 🚀 Probe Stream Throughput
actions.description: Measure sustained throughput for streams currently assigned to channels in the selected profile. Updates the throughput cache used by alternate-stream sorting.

confirm.title: Probe Stream Throughput?
confirm.message: This will open short HTTP connections to streams currently assigned to channels in the selected profile (one at a time per M3U account). Continue?

actions.label: 👁️ Manage Channel Visibility
actions.description: Enable or disable channels based on stream count.

confirm.title: Manage Channel Visibility?
confirm.message: This will disable ALL channels in the profile, then enable only channels with 1 or more streams that are not attached to other channels. Continue?

actions.label: 📊 View Check Progress
actions.description: View the current progress and ETA of the running operation (match, sort, probe, etc.).

actions.label: 📋 View Last Results
actions.description: View a summary of the last completed operation.

actions.label: 🧪 Test Regex Rules
actions.description: Preview what Stream Name Regex Rules would do, against all streams (read-only).

actions.label: 🌍 Check Stream Country Labels
actions.description: Compare each stream's group country against its EPG identifier suffix and report where they disagree. Reads two database columns, opens no provider connection, changes nothing.

actions.label: 🔍 Scan for Placeholder Patterns
actions.description: Group every stream name into a numbered family and report the families no Placeholder Name Pattern covers, with a regex to paste. Reads one database column, changes nothing

actions.label: 📧 Email Report Now
actions.description: Build the report now and queue it for email as two attachments, an HTML page and a CSV. Checks that Newsflasharr can actually deliver it first.

actions.label: 🗑️ Clear CSV Exports
actions.description: Delete all CSV export files created by this plugin.

confirm.title: Clear CSV Exports?
confirm.message: This will delete all CSV export files created by this plugin. Continue?

actions.label: 🐛 Report a Bug or Request a Feature
actions.description: Write a ready-to-paste bug report to /config/stream-mapparr/ with the version, your settings and the latest CSV, and show the issues address.

actions.label: 🔓 Clear Operation Lock
actions.description: Manually clear a stuck operation lock.

confirm.title: Clear Operation Lock?
confirm.message: This will clear the operation lock. Only do this if you're certain no operation is currently running. Continue?
